memory_candidates.content: When a plan names a gate script by its agent-system SOURCE-STORE path (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/<name>.sh), the invocation may be unrunnable: validate-context-budgets.sh, check-extension-docs.sh and check-task-references.sh all hard-refuse to run from the source store with an explicit error ('must run from a deployed scripts/ tree ... where ../.. resolves to a bogus repo root') and direct the caller to the deployed .claude/scripts/ copy. generate-context-line-counts.sh does NOT have this guard and runs fine from either path, so the failure is per-script rather than uniform -- a plan author cannot infer it from one working example. Run the deployed copy, pass the source-store index as --index, and record the substitution as a deviation rather than reporting the gate as skipped.

check-task-references.sh scans git-TRACKED files via `git ls-files`, so an untracked new file is silently skipped and a violation in it goes unreported. When a dispatch authors new files and must prove the lint reaches them, either stage/commit them first or verify coverage directly (`git ls-files <dir> | wc -l` against the file count on disk). A belt-and-braces direct grep using the canonical TASK_PATTERN from scripts/lib/task-reference-patterns.sh is cheap and makes the claim independent of git state. The same staging-first dependency applies to any lint built on `git ls-files` rather than on a filesystem walk.

A multi-file context corpus must be tiered deliberately at registration, and the budget gate will NOT catch getting it wrong for a new extension. validate-context-budgets.sh derives tier from load_when shape (always -> 1, agents non-empty -> 2, commands/task_types non-empty -> 3, all-empty -> 4) and checks per-agent token totals only against a CAPS table of ten NAMED agents. A new extension's agents are absent from CAPS, so registering N 150-250-line documents at Tier 2 fires no cap at all. The working pattern: the README index stays Tier 2 as the single eager discovery entry point, each document goes Tier 4 with load_when hooks empty AND on_demand:true (the explicit-intent marker that exempts it from the Dead Entry Check, which is keyed on on_demand precisely because tier is derived). Verify by reading back the derived tier distribution, never by trusting a green gate.
